description: This file is an implementation of the MessageService interface, providing methods for creating, sending, and managing notification messages within the OpenMRS platform. It handles message delivery, preparation, and retrieval of message templates, interacting with other components like message sender, template DAO, and context.
published: createMessage(String, String, String, String, String, String, String)
